resource: Entries of a pending reshape offer
allocation_impact: A fixed [u8; 3] in memory and a SMALLINT[] with cardinality 3 in storage; an offer is drawn only when 3 entries other than the current one exist.
boundary_tests: max=3: an offer stores 3 distinct entries other than the current one
max+1: a 4th entry cannot be stored (cardinality CHECK); a pool with 2 others is POOL_TOO_SMALL
notes: PROFICIENCY-1B §5 and §12; tests: offers_are_three_distinct_others_and_choices_keep_the_rank. Registered by OTV2-20261003-prof-shape-1.
